changelog:
This one installs normally — no uninstall needed.

WHAT'S NEW
Get started without leaving the TV. No account yet? Create one on the sign-in screen, start a free 2-day trial with no card, or buy a plan — and the Player signs you in the moment it is ready.
My Account. See what you have, how long is left on it, renew it, redeem a gift code, or switch the Player to a different service.
Your login, emailed to you. After a trial or a purchase your username and password are sent to your inbox, so losing the screen no longer means losing the account.
Vibez sign-up. Pick a package on the TV, finish on your phone, then sign in and carry on where you left off.
Remote fixes on the new screens — you can get back to the trial card, the keyboard says what it is asking for, and links no longer open a browser you did not ask for.
Plex libraries open faster.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.1 brings sign-up to the TV: create a DreamStreams account, take a free 2-day trial or buy a plan without leaving the app, and the Player signs itself in. Adds My Account with renewals and gift codes, emails you your login after a trial or purchase, and fixes a batch of remote-control issues on the new screens. Installs normally — no reinstall.
